correctness.rationale: In the sparse perfect evolution algebra the coordinate equations imply x_i=t^{2^{i-1}} and the nonzero idempotent condition becomes f=T^N+aT^M-1, N=2^n-1, M=2^{n-1}-1, N=2M+1 and gcd(N,M)=1. Parameterizing a=t^{-M}-t^{N-M} gives a degree-N connected branched rational cover. Its N finite simple critical points satisfy t^N=-M/(N-M) and have distinct critical values a=N/(N-M)*t^{-M}, by coprimality. Each finite inertia is one transposition; the infinity inertia lies in their generated subgroup by the sphere fundamental group relation. Thus the entire transitive monodromy is generated by transpositions and hence is S_N. Over invertible generic structure matrices, simultaneous homogeneous quadrics have no solutions at infinity and total Bézout length 2^n, with zero section simple; nonzero solutions form a finite étale degree-N cover on a nonempty open subset. Specializing to the sparse line, avoiding branch values, embeds its monodromy S_N in generic monodromy; hence generic geometric and arithmetic groups are S_N. Independent exact checks confirmed critical-point noncollision for n=2,3 and gcd for n=2..9; finite checks are not the all-n monodromy proof.

originality.rationale: The exact same full symmetric group assertion is stated explicitly as Conjecture 2 in a dated October 15 2026 primary survey, proved there only for n=2, with n=3 identified as open. The present sparse trinomial geometry supplies an all-dimensional solution using a classical transposition-generated cover lemma plus specialization. Existing general results about Bézout idempotent counts and existence are acknowledged; they cannot imply an S_N Galois-group computation. Priority remains best-of-knowledge because a separate rational-trinomial monodromy theorem might yield this specialization implicitly.
residual_risks: A general rational-function monodromy theorem may already imply the coprime-exponent trinomial S_N without being phrased in evolution-algebra terminology; that would reduce strength of specialization novelty, but not establish a published generic-algebra solution without pullback.

Full proof assumes characteristic zero, algebraically independent structure constants and distinct nonzero geometric solutions on the generic étale locus; arbitrary specialized coefficient matrices are not covered.

final_claim: For n>=2, over K=Q(u_ij) with n^2 independent parameters, the Galois action on the 2^n-1 nonzero geometric idempotents of a generic n-dimensional evolution algebra is the full symmetric group S_{2^n-1}. The explicit perfect one-parameter sparse family has idempotent polynomial T^(2^n-1)+a*T^(2^(n-1)-1)-1 with full geometric and arithmetic symmetric Galois group.
limitations: Characteristic zero and generic independent parameters; no assertion for every fixed specialized rational or positive-characteristic algebra.
Independent finite-field checks are supplementary and not a formal proof of monodromy.
